simple.meaning: רָקַח (râqach) appears 8 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with priesthood.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Exodus, 1 Chronicles, 2 Chronicles, Ecclesiastes, Ezekiel, beginning at Exodus 30:25. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, priesthood, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רָקַח (H7543) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows רָקַח through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: רָקַח (râqach) / H7543 is tracked through Exodus 30:25, Exodus 30:33, Exodus 30:35, Exodus 37:29. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.full: H7543. raqach [ רָקַח ] verb mix , or compound oil, ointment (perhaps denominative; in this case √ meaning unknown; Late Hebrew has מִרְקַחַת ointment ; Phoenician רקח either spice-mixer (Bloch) or spice-dealer (Lzb); perhaps akin to Assyrian ri‡‡u , spice , Meissn Suppl. 90 , compare rikkê , Dl HWB 620 ); — Qal Imperfect 3masculine singular יִרְקַח Exod 30:33 ; Participle רֹקֵחַ 30:25 ; 30:35 , ׳רוֺ 37:29 ; Eccl 10:1 ; plural construct רֹקְחֵי 1Chr 9:39 ; — mix, compound , Exod 30:33 (P; כָּמֹהוּ , i.e. anything like the holy oil); participle as substantive רֹקְחֵי הַמִּרְקַחַת 1Chr 9:30 compounders of the ointment ; as a professional name, mixer, perfumer , Exod 30:25 , 35 ; 37:29 ; Eccl 10:1 . Pu`al Participle masculine plural מְרֻקָּחִים 2Chr 16:14 mixed as ointment. Hiph`il Infinitive absolute הַמֶּרְקָחָה הַרְקַח Ezek 24:10 (|| הָתֵם ), as Imperative, spice the spicing (?), i.e. spice (the meat) well, but very dubious, Krae proposes הַמָּרָק חָרֵק empty out the broth.
